title: App Activity
story: A mobile app stores its users and one row per session. A user's referrer_id points to the user who invited them.
schemaSql: CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, username TEXT NOT NULL, referrer_id INTEGER, signup_date TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE sessions (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, session_date TEXT NOT NULL, minutes INTEGER NOT NULL, device TEXT NOT NULL);
